note: Multi-part public suffixes. A host whose last two labels appear here needs a third label to form a registrable domain: bbc.co.uk is a site, co.uk is not. Both the extension (collect/domain.ts) and the research tier (tise_research/data/chrome_history.py) read THIS file. Neither owns the list, so neither can drift from the other.
provisional: This is not the full Public Suffix List. The real PSL is ~230KB, changes monthly, and would need a staleness policy before it could be trusted in a benchmark; that is a bigger commitment than V1 has earned. See DECISIONS.md D34 for what this costs and how it is measured.
